claims: Jack Nicklaus holds the record for most Masters wins with six.
Tiger Woods has five Masters wins.
Scottie Scheffler won his second Masters title in three years with the 2024 tournament.
Jimmy Demaret won three Masters tournaments.
Sam Snead won three Masters tournaments.
Gary Player won three Masters tournaments.
Nick Faldo won three Masters tournaments.
Phil Mickelson won three Masters tournaments.
Dustin Johnson recorded a score of 268 (20-under) in the 2020 Masters, the lowest score.
Tiger Woods is the youngest Masters winner at 21 years old in 1997.
Jack Nicklaus is the oldest Masters winner at 46 years old in 1986.
The Masters tournament was not played from 1943-1945 due to World War II.
